name: 211 Tampa Bay (Crisis Center of Tampa Bay)
description: Free, confidential 24/7 phone/text/chat referral line connecting families to local mental health resources, in 180+ languages.
eligibility: Open to all Tampa Bay area residents

name: Crisis Center of Tampa Bay
description: Operates the 211 Contact Center, suicide prevention, and 24/7 crisis counseling services for the region.

name: Directions for Living
description: Behavioral health nonprofit offering counseling and psychiatric services for children and families.
eligibility: Confirm current Hillsborough service area directly

name: Hillsborough County Children's Services (CINS/FINS)
description: County-run program providing emergency shelter, respite, and community counseling for youth ages 6-17.

name: Tampa Bay Thrives - Let's Talk Line
description: Free 24/7 confidential support line connecting callers to counselors.

name: NAMI Hillsborough
description: Local affiliate of the National Alliance on Mental Illness; runs family support groups, including for parents of children with mental health conditions.

name: Ibis Healthcare - Children's Crisis Admissions
description: Youth mental-health emergency/crisis admission services in the Tampa Bay area.

name: USF Center for Autism & Related Disabilities (CARD-USF)
description: Federally/state-funded university center providing free training, consultation, and support to families and individuals with autism and related disabilities.
eligibility: Individuals with autism/related disabilities and their families, region-wide

name: Autism Society of Florida
description: Statewide chapter of the national Autism Society; runs support groups accessible to Tampa Bay families.

name: USF PEPSA Parent Support Directory
description: USF-hosted directory of parent support groups for ADHD/related conditions by county, including Hillsborough listings.
eligibility: Parents of children with ADHD/related conditions

name: LiFT Family Resource Center
description: Tampa Bay-area family resource center connecting families to a network of allied neurodivergent/disability-support organizations.

name: Healthy Start Coalition of Hillsborough County
description: Broader family/child resource hub that includes developmental and neurodivergent-adjacent referrals.

name: Metropolitan Ministries
description: Major Tampa nonprofit providing food, emergency shelter, rent/utility assistance, and family case management.
eligibility: Families facing financial hardship, Tampa Bay area

name: Feeding Tampa Bay
description: Regional food bank / hunger-relief organization serving Hillsborough and surrounding counties.

name: Trinity Cafe
description: Restaurant-style free meals for people facing food insecurity, a Feeding Tampa Bay program.

name: Catholic Charities Diocese of St. Petersburg (Hillsborough)
description: Rent, utility, and general emergency financial assistance for families in Hillsborough County.
eligibility: Families in financial crisis, Hillsborough County

name: Champions for Children
description: Nationally accredited Tampa Bay nonprofit focused on child-abuse prevention and family support; parenting education, home-visiting programs.
eligibility: Families with children, especially pregnant women/newborns through school-age

name: Bay Area Legal Services - Housing Emergency List
description: Legal aid org maintaining a curated list of housing/rent emergency assistance resources.

name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Tampa Bay
description: Low-cost/scholarship-based after-school and summer programming across multiple Tampa Bay club locations.

name: Tampa Metropolitan Area YMCA - Open Doors Financial Assistance
description: Sliding-scale membership and program discounts (summer camp, swim lessons, youth sports, before/after-school enrichment) based on need.

name: YMCA of the Suncoast - Financial Assistance
description: Sliding-scale membership and program discounts for Suncoast-area YMCA branches.
eligibility: Income-qualified families; confirm which branches serve target ZIP codes
service_area: Pinellas / parts of broader Tampa Bay region

name: Patel Conservatory / Straz Center Financial Aid
description: Need-based financial aid for dance, theater, music, and visual arts classes for youth at Tampa's Straz Center conservatory.

name: City of Tampa Parks & Recreation Youth Leagues
description: City-run low-cost youth sports leagues. No specific named scholarship/fee-waiver program confirmed - call to verify current fee-assistance options.
eligibility: Tampa youth; call (813) 744-5978 to confirm assistance options

name: Hillsborough County Parks & Recreation Program Registration
description: County-run recreation program registration hub for youth activities.

name: 211 Tampa Bay (general intake)
description: General entry point/hotline for food, rent, utility, and other family assistance programs across categories.
eligibility: Open to all Tampa Bay area residents
